title: Vibe Coding for Solopreneurs: Build a $10K MRR Product Without a Dev Team
summary: Solopreneurs are shipping real products with AI — no dev team, no agency, no months of planning. Here's how vibe coding works when you're building alone, and what separates the ones who ship from those who don't.
body_markdown: A solo build with Blink costs your time plus the platform subscription — free to start, then from $25/month. A developer hire at mid-level costs $80K–$120K annually, plus benefits, onboarding, and management overhead. A dev agency engagement for a comparable MVP starts at $5K–$15K for the first version, with ongoing retainer costs for changes. The solopreneur wins on cost at every stage until the product genuinely needs specialized engineering work — which typically doesn't happen until well past $10K MRR.
